name: Yuuki Maya
source:
The younger sister of the twins

She has a “big sisterly” personality, and she decided to become a day-care center mother because she is worried about her twin sister Miya, who is somewhat unreliable. However, in her heart of hearts, she still loves the main character as much as Miya does. 

She is good at running and climbing trees (although she is afraid of heights and cannot climb above her own height). She has low blood pressure and is weak in the morning, giving the impression that she is somewhat unsteady in the morning.

 Unlike Miya, she is not good at cooking (she says she is “practicing”). She is extremely shy, and a simple tap on the back causes her to yelp.
